_comment: Investigation mission shapes (plan P2). Executable content, NOT model-authored.
A shape composes an objective with a complication and a set of terminal branches.
Truth (route codes, forged status, recorder owner) is generated in CODE at offer
time from the mission seed -- never by a model, and never rerolled once accepted.
branch_ids must match exactly what InvestigateSignalCapability dispatches on.
Slice one ships survey_discrepancy and competing_claims; the other two are gated
on Abe's playtest of those (see the plan's human-gate H1).

shapes.preview: Two beacons disagree about a route code. Confirm which reading is correct, or file it unverified.
A recorder and a salvage bus share one power source. Only one survives.
A beacon advertises a cache. Extraction may attract a hostile; verification is available.
An archive is failing. Spend a repair kit to hold it, or travel to reconstruct a lesser copy.
